recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up a single Healthchecks.io heartbeat that the job pings after a successful sync, so the user gets an email if the ping hasn't arrived by 03:00 plus a grace period.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging, moving the job into Docker, and running monitoring on the Synology.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends email only if it reaches that step; nothing independently notices silence.
labels.Checked myself: Only your account: cron starts it at 03:00 on `edna`, and startup failures went unnoticed for four nights.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert and says it is dropping the Synology/Docker logging stack. Its 'Checked myself' line cites only facts the user provided.
